QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Concern
QuestInfo.0: #p203# of #m10001000# seems to have something on her mind.
QuestInfo.1: #p203# mentioned that although the town festival was a huge success, #p202# hasn't been feeling quite like himself lately. She asked for help finding a way to cheer him up, suggesting that #b#p205##k, who is well-versed in ancient history, might know something. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I went to see #p205# in #m10001000# to seek advice on how to raise #p202#'s spirits.

0.0: Ah, #h0#! You came at just the right time. Thanks to you, we wrapped up the town festival so well. Though, of course, we'll have to start preparing for the next one soon... But a concern has come up since then. Would you be willing to hear me out?

yes.0: Thank you. Everyone in town enjoyed the festival, but just one person—#p202#—had a shadow over his face the entire time, for some reason. No matter how delicious the food was or how lively the stories were, nothing seemed to help. He's been looking so completely drained of energy lately, I'm truly worried about him.
yes.1: So, I'd like you to go to #b#p205##k and ask him how #p202# could get his energy back. That boy is so knowledgeable about ancient history and all sorts of lore surrounding the town. I'm counting on you!

no.0: They say a close neighbor is better than a distant relative...

1.0: Oh, it's #h0#. How has life in #m10001000# been treating you? ...Pardon? #p203# is wondering how #p202# can regain his energy? Hmm... I see...

npc.0: I'm just so worried because #p202# looked so thoroughly lifeless throughout the whole festival. Could you please ask #p205# how he might regain his vitality?
